clips.send: Nodes and eclipse seasons. Where the two orbits cross. The two points where the Moon’s orbit crosses the plane of Earth’s orbit are called nodes. Every year has at least two solar eclipses (most are partial). Eclipse equals new/full Moon + near a node.
